definitions.explanation: The flat area on each side of the head between the forehead and the ear.

examples.japanese: こめかみを{押|お}さえる。
こめかみに{白髪|しらが}が{生|は}えてきた。
examples.english: Gray hair has started to grow at my temples.

notes:
こめかみ likely comes from 米噛み (rice chewing), as this area moves when chewing.

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ひたい/{額|ひたい}: forehead
- {耳|みみ}: ear
- ほほ/{頬|ほほ}: cheek

HEADACHE CONTEXT:
- Often associated with tension headaches and migraines
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}: migraine
